h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Anantapur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Anantapur

items.pText: Anantapur is one of the driest districts in Andhra Pradesh. A lawn under a playground is hard to keep green here, and bare soil turns to dust by midday. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Anantapur to schools, colleges, residential layouts and municipal parks, made at our factory in Vasai about 720 km away. We send it by road and install it with our own team or a dealer.

The surface under the equipment matters as much as the equipment itself in this climate. Grass needs regular watering that many sites cannot spare. Bare earth packs hard in the heat, which is not what you want under a slide or swing. We suggest rubber flooring under each piece's safe play area. It needs no water, cushions falls and can be swept clean of dust. Our galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof, so the dry heat and the short rainy season do them little harm.

items.q: What is the best surface under a playground in a dry area?
items.a: Rubber flooring. It cushions falls, needs no watering and can be swept clean. Grass struggles without regular water, and packed earth becomes hard and dusty in summer.
Dust does not harm galvanised steel or roto-moulded plastic, but it can build up in moving parts. Sweep the area regularly and have bearings and pivots checked as part of routine maintenance.

items.q: Do you supply rubber flooring along with the equipment?
items.a: Yes. We supply rubber flooring for play areas and can include it in the same quote and dispatch as the equipment.
